title: Consolidate first-party authorized DFIR integration candidates without changing canonical capability ownership
goal: Coordinate the already independently tested cross-capability DFIR Case Search, Timeline/source navigation and Wazuh cohort releases; do not implement runtime in this engineering epic or claim that individual product capabilities are accepted.
invariants: The new integration branch must preserve exact prior product implementation commits as ancestors, with no code rewrite, force push, or new runtime API.
The proposed merge base is the unchanged GitHub PR #113 head, not main; preserve native review and required checks of every relevant ancestor.
Never equate local synthetic owner snapshot, SHA-256 comparison, correlation leads, or green branch checks with production IAM or signed forensic custody.
security_properties: No change to first-party Case/Timeline/typed-source ACL, principal, tenant/environment isolation, or raw evidence boundaries.
Require every mandatory security and runtime check on the actual new integration HEAD; no lowering of the changed-critical-coverage 90% floor.
A branch that passes its own CI cannot be merged if protected-base/approval dependencies remain unresolved.

migration.rationale: Git-only consolidation of existing commits and engineering recovery metadata; no product runtime, datastore or schema change.

rollback.strategy: Close the consolidation PR and leave frozen parent PRs unchanged; no source code or repository history is removed.
verification: Original PR #113, #120, #122, #123 and #124 heads remain unchanged.
The original tested product code remains reachable at SHA 37c9a64714d5a0ae4a08691c69480126500b1bf8.

inputs: Existing separately reviewed first-party CAP-INV-002, CAP-INV-004 and CAP-INV-110 read-only runtime and contracts
Open release candidate PRs #113, #120, #122, #123 and #124, with original SHA and CI evidence preserved.
outputs: A correctly parented bounded integration task E10-DFIR-780A-INTEGRATION
Single independently checked release-candidate PR, no force merge, with source SHA and permission boundaries intact.
acceptance_tests: E10-DFIR-780A-INTEGRATION must pass all required checks and independent risk-based review before marking this epic verified.
Never assert canonical capability or production completion from a single green integration branch.

performance_budget.rationale: No changed executable code, data flow, queries or runtime design; reuse already measured source branch.

definition_of_ready: Existing first-party Case owner and source provider contracts are available.
Consolidation task is separately scoped with explicit input parent PR SHAs.
definition_of_done: GitHub native review / merge protection obligations retained.
